evidence.baseline: There is a critique of everything that has preceded this chapter, and it is the most serious critique the architecture faces. The critique is that the entire treatment of capture and resistance has modeled power as static. ... The most dangerous adversary Providence will face is not the one who has not read the architecture. It is the one who has read it more carefully than its builders, and who is patient enough to evolve past it.
evidence.shipped: Capture is not static. Funders, operators, political actors, vendors, and participants can learn how safeguards work and search for a path around them.

findings.diagnosis: The chapter is written as a self-critique, and the shipped opening states the conclusion without the critique. Read it more carefully than its builders is the sentence that makes the chapter necessary. The shipped list of actors is a real improvement, since it names ordinary parties rather than adversaries, and it is kept.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Two em dashes. Both were parenthetical appositives and both became comma pairs.

The shipped statement that the claim does not require a hidden enemy and that ordinary incentives are enough, and the shipped requirement that a threat model change without treating every critic or newcomer as an adversary. Both answer the voice card's warning about dissent as infection.

openQuestions: Fifth confirmed epigraph substitution. The pattern across all five is the same and the author should rule on the set rather than case by case.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. A chapter framed as a self-critique loses its reason to exist when the critique is removed and the answer kept, which is a specific form of the volume's general failure and worth naming separately.
